changelog:
- Initial release of the Giving Feedback skill.
- Transforms vague concerns into specific, kind, and actionable feedback using the Situation–Behaviour–Impact (SBI) framework.
- Supports both reinforcing (praise) and constructive feedback, with clear structure for delivery.
- Includes quality checks and anti-patterns to ensure effective, respectful communication.
- Offers opening lines and dialogue prompts to make feedback conversations constructive and collaborative.
summary: Turn a vague concern into specific, kind, actionable feedback. Use when asked to give feedback, write a feedback note, prepare to tell someone something hard...
